purpose: Original imagined coastal rock material for the Ocean tides shoreline cutaway. This is illustrative material, not a photograph of a real coast or geological measurement.
production: AI-generated original rock material using OpenAI image generation; then resized to1152x768 and encoded as WebP quality82. The generated image is clipped to an authored SVG coast profile. The waterline, high/low markers, day clock and tidal height are separate numerical illustrations.
other_assets: The small Earth globe reuses earth.webp and its existing NASA/Solar System Scope credits in ILLUSTRATION_SOURCES.json.
limits: This cutaway uses two sinusoidal high/low tides per illustrative lunar day. Its amplitude tracks the shared model range, but it is not a fluid model or a real coastal forecast. Real timing, number of daily tides and heights vary by coast.
